title: The Emperor Accepts Baghel Singh’s Conditions

blocks.text: The court realizes that an encounter is still desirable, but only if Sikh protocol is respected. Officials move to fix a meeting on S. Baghel Singh's terms, while promises of Great titles and honours are prepared to make the reception appear magnanimous rather than reluctant.

The city is then carefully stage-managed for the day of entry. Never should any butcher be seen around on that day, heralds are instructed, and the route is prepared so that no casual offense triggers disorder before the audience begins.
In effect, Delhi adapts itself to the Khalsa presence. The page shows imperial ceremony bending around Sikh conditions instead of the other way around.
